no_adcom_quote.quote: No advisory committee meeting was held for this NDA.

summary: No FDA advisory committee meeting was convened for NDA210498 (binimetinib/MEKTOVI). The Multidiscipline Review states plainly that 'No advisory committee meeting was held for this NDA,' and the approval letter explains the application 'was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because this is not the first drug in its class and there were no novel issues identified that would benefit from the Advisory Committee's expertise.' With no AdComm held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
